items.text: Tried and tried to play it but just can't get into it. Unnecessarily difficult is the best way to describe it. Not enough information to know what is going on most of the time game breaking crashes the rest of the time. Followed the prompts docked on a ship couldn't get through a door, closed the airlock and left the ship heading back to the station and died within minutes because of reasons I don't know. Game just isn't fun and too difficult to even start playing much like their other game.
items.text_zh: 试了又试想玩进去，但就是玩不进去。用“不必要的困难”来形容它最贴切。大多数时候信息不足，根本不知道发生了什么，其余时间则是游戏崩溃。跟着提示停靠在一艘船上，过不去一扇门，关上气闸离开那艘船返回空间站，几分钟内就死了，原因我根本不知道。游戏就是不好玩，而且连开始玩都太难了，很像他们的另一款游戏。

observations.description: 按提示停靠后无法穿过一扇门
observations.evidence: Followed the prompts docked on a ship couldn't get through a door
observations.evidence_zh: 跟着提示停靠在一艘船上，却过不了一扇门
